test_title: PYST 8: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means ‘A is the wife of B’.

A − B means ‘A is the son of B’.

A × B means ‘A is the husband of B’.

A ÷ B means ‘A is the father of B’.

Based on the above, how is P related to T if ‘P − Q + R ÷ S × T’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 
 A is
 
 

 Symbol
 +
 −
 ×

 Meaning
 Wife
 Son
 Husband

 to B
 
 

Given: P − Q + R ÷ S × T

P − Q → P is the son of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c634bb0c77055564d01d7f8711c80044059b69fcf6cf54ddc570023da347ec1.png] 

Q + R → Q is the wife of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/caccdeffc296e17c6d7ca21bd491adbfe09809c26f811eae38809f638bccfee8.png] 

R ÷ S → R is the father of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9021e84cd40e4f9395820a918a954e405b3eebff2f17e8ab8ed7bb6961b76ef7.png] 

S × T → S is the husband of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f99446be8941470d58a6ef2b794f9c703330cf5b118e1c1f76104b005088e46.png] 

Thus, P is T's husband’s brother or brother-in-law

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"
